name: Ludwig Wittgenstein
contribution: An Austro-British philosopher who worked in logic, philosophy of mathematics, philosophy of mind, and philosophy of language.
legacy: The later this person rejected many of the assumptions of the Tractatus, arguing that the meaning of words is best understood as their use within a given language game

checks.lead: Ludwig Josef Johann Wittgenstein ( VIT-gən-s(h)tyne; Austrian German: [ˈluːdvɪk ˈjoːsɛf ˈjoːhan ˈvɪtɡn̩ʃtaɪn]; 26 April 1889 – 29 April 1951) was an Austro-British philosopher who worked in logic, philosophy of mathematics, philosophy of mind, and philosophy of language.
